text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded three crucial years of 
her career 
with an outstanding record, 
Daring Tact is currently—

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text: Welcome hoooome, Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the racing schedule quieting down, 
I took a trip with Daring Tact up to 
Hokkaido. 
Our destination was, of course—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Look...! That banner is incredible...! 
"Welcome Home! Pride of Hidaka, 
Daring Tact & Tore-san"...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
We all pitched in to make it together! 
Welcome back to you too, Tore-san!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! You've looked after our 
Daring Tact all this time. 
That makes you one of our own local folks 
in our book!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Daring Tact, no time to lounge 
around! 
We've got a busy day ahead for you!

text_block_list.name: Town Hall Official
text_block_list.text:
—Daring Tact, Tore-san! 
Congratulations to you both!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (*Clap, clap, clap, clap...!*)

text_block_list.name: Town Hall Official
text_block_list.text:
Every last one of us was gathered around 
watching your races! 
The Shuka Sho had us on the edges of our 
seats...!

text_block_list.name: Town Hall Official
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Daring Tact, folks outside 
our town have been 
paying attention to us... Our tourism 
numbers have shot way up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Truly? 
I am so glad to hear that...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To all of you who gave me 
so much wonderful support... 
Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (*CLAP, CLAP, CLAP, CLAP, CLAP...!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Gentle Woman
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to say, but around these parts, 
we don't really have any fancy tourist 
ranches...

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
So instead, we've prepared a special 
recreational activity 
just for the Trainer! We call it— 
"Cattle Hay Feeding"!
choice_data_list:
Feeding hay to cows... That sounds like 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though, isn't that a rather standard 
experience? 
If we're talking about a real activity...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps something like... "Cow Dodging"? 
Where you dodge charging cows one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Daring Tact, you turn everything into 
training immediately! 
Besides, the cows around here aren't the 
charging kind, you know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Yes, I'm sorry. 
I was only joking!
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, Daring Tact is actually cracking 
jokes.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking a guided tour around Hidaka 
courtesy of the friendly locals—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh? 
It seems there isn't much wind today.
choice_data_list:
You're right. We should be able to take it 
nice and easy—

You're right. We should be able to take it 
nice and easy—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOOOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, it died down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! You two look like you're having 
fun! 
You're heading up the mountain after this, 
right? 
Take this lunch with you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you from the bottom of 
my heart. 
Thanks to all of you, I've—

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, Daring Tact. 
Cheering for you... 
has given us so many wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you smile happily and shine out 
there— 
that's what brings us the greatest 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Having everyone watch over me... 
makes me so incredibly happy too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seen off by the locals, the two of us 
climbed the mountain in Erimo... 
heading toward her campsite—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... 
The air here never changes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Look, even the clouds move so slowly... 
Doesn't it feel like time itself flows 
more gently?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Just a little further. Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I've seen so many different sights on the 
mainland, but... 
the view from up here truly is 
exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's not a breathtaking masterpiece 
to everyone. 
Still... to me, it's the greatest view in 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Really? 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I've pushed myself so hard 
and sprinted all the way here, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It feels like everything's returned to a 
blank slate, hasn't it? 
...What should we do next?
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I want to keep running. 
As long as everyone gives me their 
support... 
I want to answer their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Venturing out into the wider world, race 
by race... 
might be fun, too...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still... I also want to become someone who 
can pass something on to others. 
Just like Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Is that being too greedy?
choice_data_list:
Leave it to me! I'll make every last one 
come true!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Really?! 
Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're with me, Tore-san, 
I know I can handle even the steepest, 
rugged road.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you. 
For the blank future that awaits us, too—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please, keep pushing me forward, no matter 
how far. 
With your warm and caring voice!
